LanguageData.SupremeMelee_MeleeParryMeleeChance.label: melee parry melee chance
LanguageData.SupremeMelee_MeleeParryMeleeChance.descr: Chance to parry using melee weapons. Attackers melee skill is taken in account if it bypasses the parry. Dual wielders get two chances to parry.
Chance to parry a projectile using melee weapons. Attackers shooting skill is taken in account if it bypasses the parry. Dual wielders get two chances to parry.
